test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In the context of agricultural production, MSP refers to:
solution:
The correct answer is Minimum Support Price.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Minimum Support Price (MSP)

 
 
• A minimum Support Price (MSP) is recommended by the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP).
 
• MSP is a price set by the Indian government at which it purchases crops directly from the farmer.
 
• It is an important part of the agricultural policy of India.
 
• Minimum Support Price (MSP) is a form of market intervention by the Government of India to insure agricultural producers against any sharp fall in farm prices.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• MSP for 2022-23

 
 
• The highest absolute increase in MSP over the previous year has been recommended for Lentil (Masur) and Rapeseed & Mustard (Rs.**400 per quintal** each) followed by gram (Rs.**130 per quintal**).
 
• In the case of safflower, there has been an increase of Rs.**114 per quintal**, in comparison to last year.
